retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast backlit silhouette of a group standing in a field against a blinding sun, featuring a mix of gritty halftone textures and vibrant 70s-style bubble lettering.
triggerTerms: backlit band silhouette in a field
excludeWhen: modern clean digital photography is required
dark or moody low-key lighting is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A group of figures standing in a grassy field, rendered as dark silhouettes against a powerful, central sun flare that washes out the sky into a bright white and cyan gradient. The bottom half of the image is dominated by deep red and black shadows with a visible mechanical halftone dot pattern, overlaid with stylized, multi-layered decorative typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Extreme backlighting creating dark silhouettes against a bright sky
Vertical figures contrasted against a horizontal horizon line
Warm red foreground shadows transitioning to cool cyan sky
Organic human forms juxtaposed with geometric halftone textures
coreInvariants: Centralized sun flare causing lens bloom
Visible halftone or newsprint texture throughout

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A line of human silhouettes occupies the middle horizontal third, scaled to appear as a medium-long shot.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central sun flare acts as the primary light source and focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright sun, moves down through the silhouettes, and rests on the large decorative text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper sky area provides open, bright negative space that balances the dense, textured foreground.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep Red (foreground shadows and text fill)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright White (sun flare and text outlines)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the sun and silhouettes; high saturation in the red shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to red, black, cyan, and white

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Serif-based bubble letters with extreme swashes
letterConstructionRules: Thick, rounded strokes with heavy bottom weighting
Multi-layered outlines creating a 3D sticker effect
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial letters feature large, circular flourishes
Lower case 'y' and 's' have elongated, interlocking tails
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a rigid, geometric header with a fluid, decorative display title.

avoid: Modern sans-serifs for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s serif aesthetic with decorative flourishes
Matches the psychedelic, rounded display style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a group of people in a field, shot from a low angle looking up at a bright sun. Apply a heavy halftone dot filter and a color grade that transitions from deep red in the shadows to cyan in the sky. The subjects should be pure black silhouettes.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in the bottom center using a custom-drawn bubble font with thick red fills and multiple white outlines. Add a secondary geometric sans-serif title in the top left corner in black.

verificationChecks: Is the sun flare central and bright?
Are the subjects rendered as silhouettes?
Is the halftone texture visible in the red areas?
Does the bottom text have a multi-layered outline?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures in the silhouette
Balance between red and cyan tones
postGenerationChecks: Check that the halftone dots are consistent with vintage printing.
Ensure the sun flare doesn't obscure the text legibility.
Verify the red color is vibrant and not muddy.
Confirm the silhouettes have sharp, recognizable outlines.
recipe.reuseFormula: Backlit Silhouette + Halftone Texture + Psychedelic Bubble Type = 70s Rock Aesthetic
